billableExpense.title: Expense
billableExpense.summary: An approved or pending expense submission with optional Shillinq AP sync state.
billableExpense.description: Captured expense (declaratie / onkostenbon) submitted in pipelinq. When status transitions to 'approved' the expense is dispatched as an AP voucher to Shillinq through OpenRegister's WebhookService; apSyncStatus and apSyncedAt record the outcome of that one-way integration.

amount.description: Expense amount in the configured currency.
amount.title: Amount

category.description: Expense category (e.g. accommodation, travel, supplies, meals, software).
category.title: Category

client.description: UUID of the related client (pipelinq client schema).
client.title: Client

billable.description: Whether this expense is billable to the linked project/client.
billable.title: Billable

apSyncStatus.description: Shillinq AP sync state for this expense (null until the first approval event)..
apSyncStatus.title: Ap Sync Status

apSyncedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the last successful Shillinq AP dispatch..
apSyncedAt.title: Ap Synced At
